bestBets.overview: AZZURRI QUEEN has been solid on pace at her first two starts; a win close. HELLO MISTRESS also has her hoof on the till; beaten at odds-on last start but still good. The Maher trained STAR ROTATION was favourite at debut in March, racing greenly off a slow start. Has had a couple of jump-outs in preparation for his return. New stable for XIGUOUS EQUUS who has been off the scene for a while but who has shown talent. LITTLE MEDUSA may not have much size but her jump-out win was gritty. SANDZIBAR looks green but dam won at debut.

raceTips.comment: Azzurri Queen is ready to win third-up, and she's the map horse of the race. Both starts have been full of merit, she's been beaten by the barest of margins. The value in the race appears to be Little Medusa, a debutant who looks ready to go here off four recent jump outs. She can press forward and make her presence felt. Cool Victory is a work in progress but her recent work at the Flemington jump outs has been eye catching. Hello Mistress can make use of her race fitness by spearing across from b11, she is very consistent and can be in the finish again. Debutant Sandzibar wouldn't shock either.

bestBets.overview: First up since last winter, MOLVENO has been coming along well at the jump-outs; two runs were behind very nice horses. SATTIVA should get a good run to again figure in the thick of things. Nice improvement from THE JUDGE RULED at only his second run for the campaign. APACHE SUNRISE is overdue a win having been in the placings at each of his last five. FAKE FICTION returns to grass having not had the best of luck last time. LADY COLONIST has shown glimpses. WOOKIE ONE was strong late in jump-out; dam and a sibling won debuts.

raceTips.comment: Very competitive race. Apache Sunrise has had plenty of chances but is hard fit and knocking on the door. Back to 1200m looks ideal and she maps to get the run of the race behind the speed from b3. Molveno is first up off a lengthy break but she's looking fast and sharp at the jump-outs. I expect The Judge Ruled under Brad Rawiller to be sent forward, now third-up. He looks a big striding horse and if he finds the front and bowls along, he could be hard to catch. Sattva will be another in an on-pace position. She's been close her past couple, but on this map she could peak on her run once again.

bestBets.overview: AHAB has been racing in great heart on the synthetic, back to turf here with a claim. MICKIO has been placed three of four starts over this longer trip and has won at the track. DURHAM got too far back from a wide gate last time; has the inside draw this time. THE STOCK ROUTE (suited back in distance) is also down in class. FOREVER JEUNE also looks ready for the 2000m. SHARMA PRINCESS has won three times over this trip. PENDANTE was close up in a similar contest at Murtoa. The veteran MANGIONE is usually thereabouts.

raceTips.comment: Mickio is also back in grade but carries the full 63kg. His L200 was strong last start and getting out to 2000m could be the key to him. Barrier 16 does look a little tricky. Ahab is a last start winner in BM66 grade beating much stronger opposition than what he faces here, and now drops back in class. He's racing so well this prep, and maps to get a soft run behind the speed from barrier 3, but the track still in the Soft 7 range could be against him considering all his best recent form is on the Synth. Forever Jeune has enough ability to win a race like this but the step out to 2000m is a big query. Durham only broke his MDN two starts ago but looks to be an improving type, and could get the right inside run if the gaps appear.
